stem: Which of the following statements about $\text{IgE}$-mediated food allergy is true regarding its clinical presentation?

options.text: The severity of future reactions is highly predictable.
A prior history of exposure is always clearly present.
Resolution of the reaction generally occurs within 24 hours.
It always involves the digestive tract immediately.

explanation: The text states that these reactions are characterized by a short course and resolution generally within 24 hours.
rationale: Reflect on the typical duration of a single allergic episode once it has started.

optionExplanations.A: The source emphasizes that these reactions can be unpredictable in terms of their severity.
optionExplanations.B: Surprisingly, a known prior exposure history is not always present when taking clinical histories from families.
optionExplanations.C: The text states that these reactions are characterized by a short course and resolution generally within 24 hours.
optionExplanations.D: While it can involve the gut, reactions often present first with skin symptoms or respiratory issues.

originalCorrectOptionTexts: Resolution of the reaction generally occurs within 24 hours.
